containerDefinitions.name: db-init
command: export PGPASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD; psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE auth_db;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE core_db;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE notification_db;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c "CREATE USER auth_user WITH PASSWORD '3q4NbfIclOMwkPRpoic1FVkf';" && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c "CREATE USER core_user WITH PASSWORD 'Zo2Mx6TlGsr7IjuFA0RY9Owt';" && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c "CREATE USER notification_user WITH PASSWORD 'nTDaj1A6pjcAGTdrRE1lJAry';" && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE auth_db TO auth_user;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE core_db TO core_user;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE notification_db TO notification_user;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'ALTER DATABASE auth_db OWNER TO auth_user;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'ALTER DATABASE core_db OWNER TO core_user;' && psql -h $DB_HOST -U postgres -c 'ALTER DATABASE notification_db OWNER TO notification_user;'
